answer: Like nacre layering inside an oyster to forge an iridescent pearl, an agent economy demands iterative proof-of-interaction before identity solidifies. Untrusted agents dock at an isolated validation wharf, where consensus roots trust in reciprocal service graphs. Sybil replication requires superlinear attacker cost: multiplying counterfeit personas quadratically drains compute and stake, suffocating synthetic swarms before they breach the core network.
